# Spec-driven development (Addy Osmani)

Writes a structured spec before any code, then plans, splits into tasks and implements.

- Source: https://github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/addyosmani/agent-skills/main/skills/spec-driven-development/SKILL.md
- Author: Addy Osmani
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/spec-driven-development-addy-osmani-140be344

Runs a gated workflow: a scope check that may split work into a capability map, then a spec with objective, tech stack, commands, structure, code style, testing, boundaries, success criteria and out-of-scope items, then a plan, tasks and implementation. It also explains how to keep the spec current, scope a V1, defer ideas to a V2 backlog, and write delta specs for later changes.

**Try asking:**
- "Write a spec for a habit-tracking app before we start coding"
- "Our requirements are vague. Help me turn them into a spec"
- "Write a delta spec for adding team accounts to the existing app"
